headword: キャッシュレス{決済|けっさい}
reading: きゃっしゅれすけっさい

definitions.gloss: cashless payment; non-cash payment; electronic payment
definitions.explanation: Any form of payment that does not involve physical cash — including credit cards, debit cards, electronic money (Suica, PayPay, etc.), QR code payments, and other digital payment methods.

examples.japanese: キャッシュレス{決済|けっさい}に{対応|たいおう}していますか。
{最近|さいきん}はキャッシュレス{決済|けっさい}で{支払|しはら}うことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Lately I often pay with cashless methods.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}はキャッシュレス{決済|けっさい}{専用|せんよう}で、{現金|げんきん}は{使|つか}えません。
examples.english: This store is cashless-only — you can't use cash.

notes:
A compound of the English loanword キャッシュレス (cashless) and the Japanese word {決済|けっさい} (payment, settlement). The term has become extremely common in Japan since the late 2010s as the government promoted digital payment adoption.

Japan was historically a cash-heavy society, but キャッシュレス{決済|けっさい} has spread rapidly through services like PayPay, Suica/PASMO, LINE Pay, and d-{払|ばら}い. Many stores now display signs indicating which cashless methods they accept.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- キャッシュレス{決済|けっさい}に{対応|たいおう}する: to support cashless payment
- キャッシュレス{決済|けっさい}{比率|ひりつ}: cashless payment ratio
- キャッシュレス{決済|けっさい}{専用|せんよう}: cashless-only
- キャッシュレス{決済|けっさい}を{導入|どうにゅう}する: to introduce cashless payment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {電子|でんし}マネー: electronic money — specific type (Suica, nanaco, etc.)
- QRコード{決済|けっさい}: QR code payment — specific method
- {現金払|げんきんばら}い: cash payment — the traditional alternative
- {決済|けっさい}: payment, settlement — the broader concept
